chunks: Jamīl ibn Darrāj narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
Any woman who says to her husband, “I have never seen any good from you,” then her deeds are rendered void.

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman, specifically in the marital context of the narration
key_terms.حَبِطَ: became void or came to nothing

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about a wife telling her husband that she has never seen any good from him?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against severe ingratitude and hurtful speech within marriage. It emphasizes the moral gravity of a wife denying the good she has received from her husband and presents such speech as spiritually destructive.
